openFindings.title: Misspelled flag after the packet path still exits 0 in the council advisory script
openFindings.recommendation: Route the flag loop's args.unknown through the exit-2 branch and extend the typo-flag test to the flag position.

openFindings.title: Documented catalog command now exits 2 (ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs --skills-dir .skilled/skills --check)
openFindings.evidence: The catalog command exits 2 with 'unknown option: --check'; the script has no --check mode and its default run is read-only. Disclosed as Known Limitation 1; spec risk mitigation permits fix-or-list.
openFindings.recommendation: Update the catalog line to drop --check in a follow-up; keep the Known Limitations entry until then.

openFindings.title: Known Limitations misnames the rejected option in the catalog regression
openFindings.evidence: --skills-dir is read and works (checked=14 passed=14, exit 0); --check is the rejected token (exit 2). The disclosure says the script never read --skills-dir and exits 2 on it.
openFindings.recommendation: Correct the sentence to name --check and align the How-It-Was-Delivered caller claim.

openFindings.title: Unknown-option error in verify-router-sync.cjs reuses the check-ID usage suffix and contradicts itself
openFindings.evidence: verify-router-sync.cjs --bogus-xyz prints 'unknown option: --bogus-xyz' then 'usage: ... (unknown: none given)'.
openFindings.recommendation: Print a plain usage line in the unknown-option branch; keep the ID suffix only for --checks value validation.

openFindings.title: A missing --format value is reported as 'unknown --format value: undefined' (two ci scripts)
openFindings.evidence: ci-leaf-manifest-freshness.cjs --format and ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs --format both print 'unknown --format value: undefined', exit 2.
openFindings.recommendation: Distinguish a missing value (usage error: --format needs one of text, json) from an unknown value.
